# SheetJS Community Edition

Vendored ESM distribution: version 0.20.3, downloaded from the authoritative SheetJS CDN on 2026-10-21.

- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/xlsx.mjs
- Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
- License: Apache 2.0, retained in SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt.

The module runs locally; imported spreadsheets are not uploaded to SheetJS or another parser service.
